高考英语3500词 · 07英文原文

A Fair Competition

一场公平的比赛 · 167 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1The words “Faster, Higher, Stronger” express the spirit of the Olympics. But fairness is the basis of this motto. Only when you win fairly will you and your homeland deserve that glory. Yet some athletes who see little hope of winning and cannot bear the strain of training resort to cheating at the games. Medals seem to have a magical power over them, tempting them to cheat, and the prize money has replaced the motto as their only goal.

2So, in the gymnastics event to be held in our city next month, one of the host city’s responsibilities is to keep the competition fair. The organisers advertised the rules on posters outside the stadium, promising that all competitors would undergo a routine physical examination, one after another, in the gymnasium. There is no room for bargaining over this requirement. The volunteers in charge will be very strict. It is foolish to cheat because anyone caught cheating will not be admitted to the competition and will be fined.

高考英语3500词 · 07中文译文

一场公平的比赛

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1“更快、更高、更强”体现了奥林匹克精神，公平是这句格言的根基。只有赢得堂堂正正，你和你的祖国才配得上那份荣誉。可是，有些运动员既看不到获胜的希望，又受不了训练的辛苦，便在比赛中作弊。奖牌仿佛有某种魔力，诱使他们弄虚作假。奖金也取代了原来的格言，成了他们唯一的目标。

2下个月，我市将举办体操比赛，主办方的职责之一就是确保比赛公平。他们在体育场外贴出海报，承诺每位选手都要依次到体育馆接受例行体检。这件事谁都没法讨价还价。负责的志愿者会严格把关。作弊很愚蠢，因为被发现的人会被取消参赛资格，还会受到罚款。
